description: Java servlet class 'ImageUrlServlet' handling image URL requests by retrieving content and data resource information from the database and forwarding to an image view or returning a 404 error.

classes.name: ImageUrlServlet
classes.description: Servlet class that processes image URL requests, retrieves content and data resource info from the database, and forwards to an image view or returns an error.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests by delegating to doGet method.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve image content based on URL path, queries database for content and data resource, and forwards to image view or returns 404.
